summary: Tested 5 surgical changes for B Livre/ADM scope only (no marketplace). Backend 10/10 pytest passed for /api/public/support (no auth) and /api/admin/support (admin). Frontend Playwright: AuthPage exposes data-testids 'forgot-account-link' and 'talk-to-support-link'; clicking opens 'public-support-modal'; submit produces 'Tudo certo!' state and 'Solicitação enviada com sucesso' toast. /blivre header bell opens notifications drawer (empty state correctly shown). Mobile FAB messages (title='Mensagens') triggers activeFilter='messages' and renders [data-testid='blivre-back-from-messages']. Mobile gold '+' Anunciar FAB present. Marketplace pages (Profile/Orders/Cart/Wallet/Notifications) have NO MobileBackButton import — scope respected. /manifest.json and /sw.js return 200. PWAInstallButton component imported in SocialPage at lines 2156 & 2196 (renders only on real beforeinstallprompt — expected hidden in Playwright).
critical_code_review_comments: Public support endpoint correctly sanitizes input (sanitize_text) and validates email (must contain @ and .).
Endpoint sets is_public=true and user_id='public' so admin list filter logic remains compatible.
Best-effort admin notification insert wrapped in try/except — good resilience.

PWAInstallButton uses localStorage gate (3 visits, hide after install/dismiss) — cannot be functionally validated in headless Playwright (beforeinstallprompt event not fired); current contract met by mounting component in DOM.
Back-arrow test-ids ([blivre-back-from-messages], [blivre-back-from-chat]) only render conditionally on activeFilter==='messages' — confirmed working via Mobile FAB.
seed_data_creation: Tests insert ~7 TEST_-prefixed public support tickets in support_messages collection (categories: support/recovery). Not auto-cleaned (no DELETE endpoint for support tickets). Negligible volume; non-blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 requested ajustes verified and working: (1) public/support endpoint + AuthPage modal end-to-end OK, (2) bell drawer opens (empty state shown — no messages to validate item-as-button transformation in this seed; needs at least one notification document for buyer/admin to fully verify items rendered as <button>), (3) gold '+' FAB visible on mobile, sidebar contraction (sticky layout) is a CSS behavior — not functionally tested, (4) PWAInstallButton mounted but only shows on real Chromium with PWA prompt, (5) mobile back arrow data-testids present and visible. Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_public_support.py (10 tests, all green). Marketplace scope NOT modified.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects found in this scope.
